resumen: The bar travels down along the legs while the hips go back and the knees stay nearly fixed. It is the reference hip hinge for hamstrings and glutes.
ejecucion: Stand with the bar hanging at thigh height and your feet hip-width apart.
Push the hips back and let the bar slide down along your legs, knees almost fixed.
Go as low as you can keep a flat back: the moment it starts to round, that is your limit.
Come back by driving the hips forward until you stand tall, without leaning the shoulders back.
matices: In the Romanian deadlift, the cited review finds more hamstring than erector activity, unlike the other deadlift variations. The distribution changes with the variation and how it is measured, so the roles here describe the movement, not a measurement.
